Pagination

A nav with an ol of links. The current page is aria-current="page", disabled edges are a span with role="link" and aria-disabled="true". No class and no JavaScript needed.

Other label with data-pagination

The default hook is aria-label="Pagination". When the label says something else, add data-pagination. The navs on this page use it so each one has its own label.

Set --pico-pagination-item-size on the nav.
